summary: Colville NF lookout on Huckleberry Mountain, Pend Oreille County: pole L-4 cab from the 1930s, timber R-6 tower from 1964, removed in 1979.

facts.design: 20-foot pole tower with L-4 cab (1930s); replaced in 1964 by a 20-foot treated timber tower with R-6 cab
facts.status_note: Tower and cab removed in 1979; WillhiteWeb photo captions (undated) mention footings and stairs
facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service, Colville National Forest

visit.trail_note: WillhiteWeb says the road is pretty good to near the top, a high-clearance SUV could easily make it to the top, and the last several hundred feet have some rocky sections

events.note: White Bluffs Spokesman item of June 19, 1925: a new lookout would be erected that summer on Huckleberry mountain; not reconciled with the register's 1930s date
Decade only: register says the 20-foot pole L-4 tower was built in the 1930s; a 1925 item said a new lookout would be erected that summer
Lookout person stationed by mid-May 1939; earliest staffing in the sources read. Lookouts installed that week per a May 20, 1939 item
Known lookout personnel listed for 1955, 1957, 1958 and 1959 (four people)
20-foot treated timber tower with R-6 cab replaced the pole tower
Seasonal technician worked the lookout July 6 to late August 1976; taken down early for lack of fire weather

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register dates the pole tower to the 1930s. A 1925 item quoted by Forest Lookouts says a new lookout would be erected that summer, and a May 1939 item says lookouts were installed that week. Not reconciled; the story gives the register's decade and notes the other items without choosing one.

notes_for_editor: No access level given: no source says whether the summit is open to visitors today, so facts.access is omitted. Willhite photo captions ('Footings and stairs', 'First footings from second set of footings') are undated; the story says so. A Forest Lookouts South Huckleberry entry (Ferry County, a different mountain) quotes a 1930 item about a 'Huckleberry mountain' lookout; not used, because it may refer to this site or to another. Personnel names from firelookout.com and WillhiteWeb were left out of the story. Brief coordinates (48.76102, -117.54304) match the register and firelookout.org list. No new photos recorded because captions are not linked to image URLs.
